passage.label: Ali 'Imran — Angels said O Maryam Allah chose you purified you chose you above women of worlds; O Maryam be obedient to your Lord prostrate bow with those who bow; that is from news of unseen We reveal to you; you were not with them when cast pens who should sponsor Maryam nor when they disputed; when angels said O Maryam Allah gives glad tidings of Word from Him name Messiah Isa son of Maryam distinguished in dunya and akhirah among those brought near; speaks to people in cradle and maturity among righteous; she said my Lord how can I have child no man touched me; said thus Allah creates what He wills when decrees matter says Be and is; teaches him Book wisdom Torah Gospel; messenger to Children of Israel: I came with sign from Lord; create from clay like bird form breathe into it becomes bird by Allah's leave; heal blind leper revive dead by Allah's leave; inform what you eat store in houses; in that sign for you if believers; confirming Torah before me; make lawful some forbidden; came with sign from Lord so fear Allah obey me; indeed Allah my Lord your Lord worship Him straight path

arabicExcerpts.text: وَإِذۡ قَالَتِ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَٰمَرۡيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصۡطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصۡطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
يَٰمَرۡيَمُ ٱقۡنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ وَٱسۡجُدِي وَٱرۡكَعِي مَعَ ٱلرَّـٰكِعِينَ
ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيۡكَۚ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيۡهِمۡ إِذۡ يُلۡقُونَ أَقۡلَٰمَهُمۡ أَيُّهُمۡ يَكۡفُلُ مَرۡيَمَ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيۡهِمۡ إِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
إِذۡ قَالَتِ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَٰمَرۡيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٖ مِّنۡهُ ٱسۡمُهُ ٱلۡمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ وَجِيهٗا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَمِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ
وَيُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِي ٱلۡمَهۡدِ وَكَهۡلٗا وَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
قَالَتۡ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي وَلَدٞ وَلَمۡ يَمۡسَسۡنِي بَشَرٞۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ ٱللَّهُ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

وَرَسُولًا إِلَىٰ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ أَنِّي قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ أَنِّيٓ أَخۡلُقُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيۡـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيۡرِ فَأَنفُخُ فِيهِ فَيَكُونُ طَيۡرَۢا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَأُبۡرِئُ ٱلۡأَكۡمَهَ وَٱلۡأَبۡرَصَ وَأُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا تَأۡكُلُونَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُونَ فِي بُيُوتِكُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
وَمُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِ وَلِأُحِلَّ لَكُم بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي حُرِّمَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۚ وَجِئۡتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ

mainSubject.label: Maryam's election and purification: chosen above all women; commanded to devout obedience, prostration, and communal worship; revelation of unseen knowledge to Prophet Muhammad; pen-casting dispute over Maryam's guardianship as proof of prophetic knowledge; angelic annunciation of Isa as Kalimah from Allah, Messiah, distinguished in both worlds, among muqarrabin; Isa speaks in cradle and maturity; virgin birth: kun fayakoon creative command; Isa taught Book, Wisdom, Torah, Gospel; Isa's mission to Bani Isra'il with four signs: clay bird animated by divine permission, healing blind and leper, reviving dead by divine permission, knowledge of hidden food stores; signs conditional on belief; confirmation of prior Torah; partial abrogation of prohibitions; call to taqwa and obedience; tawheed declaration: Allah is my Lord and your Lord; straight path

notes: Pass A Imran passage 6/8. Core Isa narrative block. Four miracles enumerated with bi-idhnillah qualifier emphasizing divine agency. Kun fayakoon links Isa's creation to Adam's (3:59). Cradle speech unique to Quranic Isa account. Partial legislative authority (tahlil ba'd al-muharram) distinctive.
